title: EyeClean process job (eyeclean.job/1)
description: Input to `eyeclean process --job FILE` and eyeclean.api.process(job=...). Keys mirror the CLI's long options (dashes become underscores). Command-line flags override job values. Relative paths are resolved against the job file's directory.

input.description: video file, EXR directory, printf pattern (%06d), #### pattern or glob

output.description: output directory (created; must not be the input's directory)

model.description: registry model name (see `eyeclean models`) or a .safetensors path; default: the registry default

fps.description: image sequences only: constant frame rate, exactly as a ratio for NTSC rates ("60000/1001")

timestamps.description: image sequences only: JSON list or text lines of per-frame seconds

max_region.description: single-channel EXR limiting where edits may happen (full-frame, one file for the whole clip)

cancel_file.description: the run stops (exit 7) when this file appears

client.description: free-form caller metadata (shot id, pipeline version...), recorded in RUN_REPORT.json
